sloka: विविधा विविधैः पुष्पैः तैः एव नगसानुषु ।विस्तेएर्णाः पीत रक्ताभा सौमित्रे प्रस्तराः कृताः ॥४-१-९०॥
transliteration: vividhā vividhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ taiḥ eva nagasānuṣu ।visteerṇāḥ pīta raktābhā saumitre prastarāḥ kṛtāḥ ॥4-1-90॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri varieties of colourful flowers, some red and some yellow, are spread out on the mountain slopes.
